verdict.rationale: Rainforest markets pre-built embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks and onboarding (docs-15). The Component Studio lets you design and configure those components for your platform (docs-11, docs-39), and component sessions authorize them in the browser (docs-24). Payout data is reachable through a deposits API and webhooks (docs-7, docs-8), but nothing explicitly shows embeddable seller-facing balance, payout or transaction-history views. missing for 10: explicit embeddable balance/payout/transaction-history components, documented white-label branding controls, detail on what the reporting component contains, independent or hands-on corroboration.
